title: Nutritious Syrian Fish Bowl
description: A pungent and velvety Syrian dish featuring ciabatta and fish, served in a dolsot stone bowl. This crowd-pleaser is a pescatarian-friendly option for any meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the ciabatta into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the brine-wet fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, sumac, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the cooked fish and toss to coat.
To assemble the bowls, place a slice of toasted ciabatta in the bottom of a dolsot stone bowl.
Add a piece of the cooked fish on top of the ciabatta.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
